review_text: 8 days in Cancun with my family. Loved All-inclusive spa day - absolutely worth it. Do not miss Isla Mujeres catamaran. Chichen Itza day trip was nice but a bit overrated. Mid-range hotels were comfortable and fairly priced. Very kid-friendly. Worth a visit if you are into beach.
